theorems.name: Submission.dsmc_tangent_projection_field
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (y₀ : Euclid P), IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N → y₀ ∈ N ∩ U → ∃ (r β : ℝ) (Pt : Euclid P → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P)), 0 < r ∧ 0 ≤ β ∧ closedBall y₀ (3 * r) ⊆ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Pt (ball y₀ (3 * r)) ∧ (∀ y ∈ ball y₀ (3 * r), ∀ u w : Euclid P, inner ℝ (Pt y u) w = inner ℝ u (Pt y w)) ∧ (∀ y ∈ ball y₀ (2 * r), ‖fderiv ℝ Pt y‖ ≤ β) ∧ (∀ q ∈ N ∩ ball y₀ (3 * r), ∀ u : Euclid P, Pt q u ∈ tangentSpace N q) ∧ (∀ q ∈ N ∩ ball y₀ (3 * r), ∀ u ∈ tangentSpace N q, Pt q u = u)
